gameDescriptionHtml:
From the creators of Monument Valley, Desta: The Memories Between is a heartfelt strategy game where you fall into a mysterious dreamworld. Grab your emotionally-charged ball, track your opponent’s strategy and work tactically with your ultimate dream-team to throw the best shot and get to the heart of the conversation.

Desta: The Memories Between combines ustwo games’ approach to character storytelling with distinctive team-based tactics and physics gameplay, featuring strategic chess-like play with perfect physics precision.

This game contains themes of self-reflection, anxiety, mental health, loss of parental figures and gender identity. Player discretion is advised.

Game Features

  • FALL INTO DREAMS. Every night, Desta falls into the mysterious dreamworld, filled with shattered remnants of locations past, memories of regret-filled relationships, and powerful glowing balls that can change the course of conversation
  • PLAY A SURREAL BALL GAME. Overcome tactical challenges with perfect throws, shoot spirited trick shots and land sensational hits in turn-based sports-style encounters. As nights progress, Desta will become more experienced and attuned to this surreal world, discovering new abilities and ways to win
  • MEET POWERFUL FRIENDS. Brought to life with a full voice cast, Desta will meet all sorts of interesting and strange characters throughout their journey, all with exceptional abilities and powers, each with their own story to tell about their connection to this world
  • FIND YOUR INNER STRENGTH. As Desta and their friends fall deeper into the dream, uncover and level up brand new abilities that will completely flip encounters on their head
  • A PERSONAL STORY, DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE. From beginning to end, being approachable is a core value of all ustwo games. Desta: The Memories Between is designed for players of all skill levels to be able to experience the full journey
